name: AI Auto Responder Light
author: Alina

sections.description:
AI Auto Responder Light automatically replies to messages received via Contact Form 7 using OpenAI’s powerful language model. Instantly send professional, personalized replies, store conversation logs, and manage everything from a clean tabbed interface in your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features (Light version):
– Configure your OpenAI API key and business description
– Logs all conversations (last 20 entries)
– Tabbed settings UI for easy setup

Upgrade to Pro to unlock WooCommerce, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Formidable, custom email templates, model selection, and more.

PRO Features

Upgrade to Pro for:
* License activation and auto-updates
* Integrations with WPForms, Ninja Forms, Formidable & WooCommerce
* Custom “From” address and email templates
* AI model selector (GPT-3.5, GPT-4)
* Advanced prompt templates & conditional rules
* Priority premium support

Disclaimer

AI Auto Responder Light is a tool that connects your WordPress site to AI services such as OpenAI via your own API key. You are responsible for:
– Providing and safeguarding your own API key
– Complying with the OpenAI Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
– Reviewing and verifying AI-generated content before acting on it
– Securing any data stored on your server via this plugin

The developer is not liable for any issues, damages, or legal consequences resulting from plugin use or AI-generated content. Consult legal counsel if needed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-auto-responder-light folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to AI Auto Responder → Settings, enter your OpenAI API key and business description
  4. Ensure your CF7 forms include the fields your-name, your-email and your-message
  5. That’s it—your site will now auto-reply to form submissions!
